tools.title: PC electricity cost calculator
tools.description: Turn measured wall power, usage time and your electricity rate into a daily, 30-day and annual budget.
tools.answer: Use measured power at the wall. CPU TDP and graphics-card power ratings are not measurements of a complete PC’s electricity consumption.

tools.title: Compare complete PC upgrade costs
tools.description: Compare two CPU-platform budgets, including the board, memory, cooler and other required spending.
tools.answer: This is a manual budget, not a live store-price comparison. Use the same currency and checkout treatment in both options.

tools.title: Monitor pixel density and size calculator
tools.description: Calculate pixels per inch and rectangular display dimensions from resolution and diagonal size.
tools.answer: Pixel density describes the number of pixels per inch. It does not measure contrast, input lag, HDR quality or motion clarity.

tools.title: Recording storage budget calculator
tools.description: Estimate storage from a combined video/audio bitrate, recording duration and a manual allowance.
tools.answer: Use the combined bitrate of the streams you intend to record. Variable-bitrate footage can depart from the chosen average.

tools.title: Local AI model memory planner
tools.description: Calculate approximate weight storage and add deliberate budgets for runtime allocations and the KV cache.
tools.answer: This is a planning lower bound plus your manual allowances. It does not certify that a particular model will load, fit entirely in VRAM or run at a useful speed.

tools.title: FPS and refresh interval calculator
tools.description: Translate FPS and display refresh rate into milliseconds per frame and refresh interval.
tools.answer: This translates rates into intervals. It does not predict your PC’s FPS or measure input latency.

tools.title: B650 TOMAHAWK slot-sharing checker
tools.description: Check the documented M2_3/PCI_E2 rule and the Ryzen 8500/8300 restriction on M2_2.
tools.answer: This tool applies only to MAG B650 TOMAHAWK WIFI. It is not a general B650 or AM5 compatibility engine.
